Explain the example for declare route files

blocks.text: A route config maps addresses to route modules. An index route is the default page for its parent address.

Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.

blocks.title: Declare route files

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `route("books", ...)` maps the books address to a named route module.

blocks.text: The home module handles /, and the books module handles /books once those files are created.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Route file paths are relative to the app directory. Create the named files.
